In one of the discussions, Thrall mentioned the importance of supporting local businesses alongside the garden project. Specifically, Thrall stated, "Looks like we're all on the same page about this project! Keep sharing your thoughts, everyone! Can't wait to see the combined efforts of our garden and local businesses shine! 🌼🌍". This indicates that Thrall suggested creating a space within the garden specifically designed to showcase and support local businesses. 

Another example of Thrall emphasizing the importance of this partnership is when he said, "Everyone's enthusiasm is contagious! I'm thrilled about our plans for the garden and how they intertwine with supporting local businesses. Let's keep brainstorming!" This shows that Thrall advocated for integrating local vendors and businesses into the garden design and activities, ensuring their participation and showcasing their products and services.
